title: Emberveil Status Effects File (v1)
description: Canonical resolved STATUS_META data. This is the live runtime value of the STATUS_META const formerly inlined in src/game/statusEffects.js. Single source of truth for status icon glyph, ring color, display name, and player-friendly description. All per-status combat LOGIC stays elsewhere; only the metadata const moved here.

statusMeta.description: Map of status id -> display metadata. The key is the runtime status type string.

glyph.description: Single character shown in the HUD icon badge.

color.description: CSS color for the icon ring and glyph.
